overview.en:
Explore MongoDB collections, inspect schemas, run queries and analyze database performance.

Inspect collections and document structure before preparing queries. Keep the collection, filters, and requested fields explicit so the result can be checked against the question.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
浏览 MongoDB 集合、检查结构、执行查询并分析数据库性能。

准备查询前检查集合与文档结构，明确集合、筛选条件和所需字段，使结果可以按原始问题核对。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Inspect this collection and summarize its document structure.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这个集合，汇总文档结构。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a query for these records and explain the filtering logic.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这些记录准备查询，并解释筛选逻辑。

starterPrompts.en: Analyze the returned documents and identify inconsistent fields.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 分析返回的文档，找出不一致字段。
